summary: JARVIS Licensing & Subscription v1.0 verified end-to-end. BACKEND (20/20 pytest PASS in test_subscription.py): GET /api/subscription returns free entitlement (tier/status/trialDaysRemaining=0/inGrace=false/trialUsed=false), env='development', trialDays=30, graceDays=3; 401 without token. POST /start-trial sets tier=pro/status=trial/trialUsed=true with 28-30 days remaining and persists via GET; second call returns 400 'Trial already used'. POST /restore and /validate both return status='not_configured' with entitlement. POST /developer/set covers every action correctly: free (free/none), trial (pro/trial/30d/trialUsed=true), pro (pro/active), shop (shop/active), expired (free/expired/inGrace=false), grace (pro/grace/inGrace=true), reset_trial (trialUsed=false, allows new trial), clear (free/none/trialUsed=false). Unknown action -> 400. Persistence verified via GET /subscription. Auth regression PASSED: /register, /login and /me all include entitlement object. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile web): registered fresh account -> landed on tabs with Free entitlement (OBD-II auto-connected, 4 DTCs on Command tab). All 5 gated screens (/advanced-scan, /health-report, /record, /trends, /predictions) render PremiumGate for Free user (gate-required-tier + gate-upgrade visible; badge 'Included in JARVIS Pro'). Garage->settings-button (present) navigates to About. About page: 7 taps on about-version reveals 'Developer Mode unlocked' + Developer Options button. Developer screen: dev-license-pro tapped -> all 5 gated screens now open normally with no PremiumGate (workflow-full visible on advanced-scan). Upgrade screen: upgrade-current-plan shows 'JARVIS Pro / Trial - 30 days left' after Pro sim, feature comparison table (Connection/Diagnostics rows visible), plan cards for Free/Pro/Shop with UPGRADE TO JARVIS SHOP CTA, monthly/annual toggle, upgrade-restore visible. Set back to Free -> upgrade-start-trial appears, tapping it changes plan status to Trial (day count reflected). All flows working. Minor: PremiumGate badge reads 'Included in JARVIS Pro' rather than review's expected 'Requires JARVIS Pro' — semantically equivalent, not a bug. Carried-over cosmetic RN-web warnings: shadow* style props and pointerEvents prop deprecations (already known from iter-8/9).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:153 compute_entitlement — Handles trial expiration, grace period, and expired subscription correctly. State machine covers all 5 tiers/statuses cleanly. Good.
server.py:1398 start_trial — Correctly gates on trial_used; sets trial_end at now+30d; persists atomically via $set. Returns the reconciled entitlement. Good.

server.py:1436 developer_set — Gated by APP_ENV != 'production' (returns 403 in prod). All 8 actions computed correctly and persisted. reset_trial only downgrades to free if currently on trial (correct). clear resets everything including trialUsed. Good.
server.py:130 public_user — Now embeds compute_entitlement(u) so register/login/me all carry it. Correct additive change; no legacy fields removed.
LicenseProvider.tsx:78 initial-load effect — Loads cache first for offline-first paint then revalidates. bootedFor ref prevents double-boot on the same user. Correct.
LicenseProvider.tsx:55 refresh — Guests + logged-out force DEFAULT_ENTITLEMENT and skip backend. Good.
PremiumGate.tsx:19 useEntitlement — Renders required tier via TIER_LABELS[requiredTier]; router.push('/upgrade') on gate-upgrade tap. gate-back and gate-continue both call router.back(). Good.
featureRegistry.ts — Single-source registry of features->tiers; screens read via tierHasFeature() and never hardcode tier checks. Good architecture.
server.py: file remains ~1495 lines — advisory only (carried over): consider splitting auth/vehicles/intelligence/diagnostics/subscription into modules. Not blocking.
